reading.why_absence_cannot_be_claimed: main.tsx is in this bucket and main.tsx necessarily ships (it is the entry that mounts the app) - so a missed marker measures nothing about the bundle. Only the positive verdicts are used; the two misses are named so nobody reads them as 'not on the phone'.
reading.why_no_headline_leg_count: the two instruments' anchors are not canonicalised onto call lines yet (her comment-line and blank-line anchors sit in this union next to my call-line ones, and two of her anchors duplicate two of my legs), so a leg COUNT from this union would be a made-up number. Per-file presence in the served bundle is anchor-independent, so that is what this receipt claims. Canonicalising the site list is exactly ORD-0315's job.

caveats: presence of a UI literal proves the module SHIPPED, not that a user can reach the press in the current demo state; reachability of a button still needs the phone-side run, which is HJ-P3's lane
